data.title: Video: hombre empuja a adulto mayor a la calle y un tráiler lo atropella y mata en México
data.description: Monterrey, México.- La muerte de un adulto mayor que fue atropellado por un tráiler en una avenida de Monterrey , México, es investigada como un posible homicidio luego de que las autoridades analizaran imágenes de las cámaras de seguridad de la zona. El hecho ocurrió el jueves 6 de agosto de 2026 en el cruce de las avenidas Ruiz Cortines y Conchello . Inicialmente, el caso fue reportado como un atropellamiento; sin embargo, las grabaciones obtenidas por el sistema de videovigilancia C4 muestran una secuencia que llevó a las autoridades a modificar la línea de investigación. Según las imágenes, la víctima caminaba por la acera cuando otro hombre se acercó y, aparentemente de manera intencional, la empujó hacia la vía. El adulto mayor cayó sobre la capa asfáltica justo cuando circulaba un tráiler. El conductor de la unidad pesada continuaba su recorrido por la avenida y, de acuerdo con la información difundida por las autoridades, no habría tenido tiempo suficiente para evitar al peatón. El adulto mayor murió en el lugar, al ser aplastado por las pesadas llantas del automotor. La Secretaría de Seguridad de Monterrey informó que las divisiones de Inteligencia e Investigación trabajan para identificar y localizar al hombre que aparece en las grabaciones. La investigación fue reclasificada como homicidio, por lo que el conductor del tráiler no sería considerado responsable de la muerte, de acuerdo con los primeros avances del caso. Hasta el momento, las autoridades tampoco han establecido qué habría motivado al sospechoso a empujar a la víctima. El presunto responsable fue descrito como un hombre que vestía una camiseta blanca con un logotipo "Champions", shorts oscuros y tenis negros. También llevaba una mochila y aparentemente una gorra. Las autoridades continúan con el análisis de las imágenes y otras diligencias para determinar su identidad y establecer con precisión cómo ocurrieron los hechos. La víctima, cuya edad se estima entre los 60 y 65 años, todavía no había sido identificada públicamente hasta el viernes 7 de agosto.
data.translatedTitle: Video: man pushes an older adult into the street and a trailer runs over and kills him in Mexico
data.translatedDescription: Monterrey, Mexico.- The death of an older adult who was run over by a trailer on an avenue in Monterrey, Mexico, is being investigated as a possible homicide after authorities analyzed images from security cameras in the area. The event occurred on Thursday, August 6, 2026 at the intersection of Ruiz Cortines and Conchello avenues. Initially, the case was reported as a hit-and-run; However, the recordings obtained by the C4 video surveillance system show a sequence that led the authorities to modify the line of investigation. According to the images, the victim was walking on the sidewalk when another man approached and, apparently intentionally, pushed her onto the road. The older adult fell on the asphalt layer just as a trailer was driving. The driver of the heavy vehicle continued his journey along the avenue and, according to the information released by the authorities, he would not have had enough time to avoid the pedestrian. The older adult died at the scene, after being crushed by the heavy tires of the car. The Monterrey Security Secretariat reported that the Intelligence and Investigation divisions are working to identify and locate the man who appears in the recordings. The investigation was reclassified as homicide, so the driver of the trailer would not be considered responsible for the death, according to the first progress of the case. So far, authorities have also not established what motivated the suspect to push the victim. The alleged perpetrator was described as a man wearing a white t-shirt with a "Champions" logo, dark shorts and black tennis shoes. He was also carrying a backpack and apparently a cap. The authorities continue with the analysis of the images and other procedures to determine his identity and establish precisely how the events occurred. The victim, whose age is estimated to be between 60 and 65, had not yet been publicly identified as of Friday, August 7.

data.title: Mujer y sus dos hijos iban en moto cuando una rastra los impactó en Sabá; murió un menor
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -Un niño de 7 años perdió la vida al colisionar una motocicleta con una rastra en la carretera CA-13 a inmediaciones de la comunidad de Elixir en el municipio de Sabá, Colón. En el mismo accidente vial, la madre del menor al igual que su hermana de 3 años, resultaron heridas, por lo que fueron trasladadas a un centro asistencial. El fallecido fue identificado por personal del Cuerpo de Bomberos que atendió la emergencia como Johan Jesús Acosta García, de 7 años de edad, quien al ser evaluado ya no presentaba signos vitales. En el percance vial resultaron con heridas la menor Milly Cristal Acosta García, de 3 años de edad, quien presentaba un golpe y laceraciones leves en su cabeza, y su madre Mirna Esperanza García de 28 años de edad. Se dio a conocer que el fallecido junto a su madre y hermana se trasladaban en una motocicleta y sufrieron el fatal accidente de tránsito al colisionar con el pesado vehículo en la CA-13. El informe preliminar dicta que los vehículos involucrados en el accidente que ocurrió en horas de la madrugada de este sábado son: un tráiler color verde el cual transportaba raquis de palma hacia la ciudad de San Pedro Sula y era conducido por Lucio Escoto y la motocicleta color negro que era conducida por Mirna Esperanza García. Las autoridades llegaron a reconocer el cuerpo del menor para ser trasladado a la morgue donde se le practicó la autopsia. Mientras que agentes de la Dirección Nacional de Vialidad y Transporte (DNVT) iniciaron las investigaciones para determinar la responsabilidad de los conductores que participaron en el accidente entre la motocicleta y la rastra.
data.translatedTitle: Woman and her two children were riding a motorcycle when a tractor-trailer hit them in Sabá; a minor died
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -A 7-year-old boy lost his life when a motorcycle collided with a harrow on the CA-13 highway near the community of Elixir in the municipality of Sabá, Colón. In the same road accident, the minor's mother, as well as his 3-year-old sister, were injured, so they were taken to a care center. The deceased was identified by personnel from the Fire Department who responded to the emergency as Johan Jesús Acosta García, 7 years old, who when evaluated no longer showed vital signs. In the road accident, minor Milly Cristal Acosta García, 3 years old, who had a blow and minor lacerations to her head, and her mother Mirna Esperanza García, 28 years old, were injured. It was announced that the deceased along with his mother and sister were traveling on a motorcycle and suffered a fatal traffic accident when they collided with the heavy vehicle on CA-13. The preliminary report dictates that the vehicles involved in the accident that occurred in the early hours of this Saturday are: a green trailer which was transporting palm rachis to the city of San Pedro Sula and was driven by Lucio Escoto and the black motorcycle that was driven by Mirna Esperanza García. The authorities recognized the body of the minor to be transferred to the morgue where the autopsy was performed. While agents from the National Directorate of Roads and Transportation (DNVT) began investigations to determine the responsibility of the drivers who participated in the accident between the motorcycle and the harrow.

data.title: Octavio Pineda confirma aspiración presidencial: "El plan Bukele lo vamos a hacer en Honduras"
data.description: Yoro, Honduras.- Octavio Pineda , exministro de la Secretaría de Infraestructura y Transporte (SIT) en el gobierno de Xiomara Castro , confirmó su aspiración presidencial por el partido Libertad y Refundación (Libre). El también exdirector del Fondo Hondureño de Inversión Social (FHIS) en la administración anterior estuvo en Yoro y allí sostuvo un encuentro con líderes y militantes del partido. Pineda organizó un conversatorio con simpatizantes de Libre para abordar diversos temas, entre ellos el de la seguridad en Honduras . Al ser consultado sobre qué hará para combatir el flagelo de la inseguridad, afirmó que replicará el plan Bukele en territorio hondureño. "Rápido y puntual: cero tolerancia con esos sinvergüenzas y dos, el plan Bukele, lo vamos a hacer aquí en Honduras", adujo. Octavio Pineda se convierte en el segundo precandidato presidencial de Libre para las elecciones primarias del 2029, la otra candidata sigue siendo Rixi Moncada. En sus redes, Pineda informó que "voy a visitar toda Honduras. Estaré avisando con antelación cada visita para que me acompañen los que deseen, los quiero mucho a todos". El plan Bukele fue lanzado en El Salvador bajo el nombre "Plan de Control Territorial", el cual generó una ruptura en la relación entre el gobierno y las pandillas, que previamente habían tenido un pacto en prisión para líderes pandilleros. Este plan incluyó un régimen de excepción que permitió detenciones sin orden judicial, amplió el tiempo de detención administrativa y autorizó la intervención de las telecomunicaciones. Además, el gobierno movilizó al Ejército y la Policía Nacional Civil para capturar a salvadoreños con antecedentes policiales y penales en comunidades peligrosas. Otro aspecto dentro del plan de Nayib Bukele es que se realizaron cambios en el sistema judicial, incluida la eliminación de nombres de jueces en casos relacionados con el régimen de excepción. Diversos sectores en Honduras han afirmado que este plan no se puede aplicar en territorio nacional, en primer lugar por la diferencia en tamaño geográfico de  El Salvador y Honduras, otros sectores aducen que sí y Octavio Pineda adelantó que lo hará si llegara a Casa Presidencial.
data.translatedTitle: Octavio Pineda confirms presidential aspiration: "We are going to do the Bukele plan in Honduras"
data.translatedDescription: Yoro, Honduras.- Octavio Pineda, former minister of the Secretariat of Infrastructure and Transportation (SIT) in the government of Xiomara Castro, confirmed his presidential aspiration for the Libertad y Refoundación (Libre) party. The former director of the Honduran Social Investment Fund (FHIS) in the previous administration was in Yoro and there held a meeting with party leaders and activists. Pineda organized a conversation with Libre supporters to address various issues, including security in Honduras. When asked about what he will do to combat the scourge of insecurity, he stated that he will replicate the Bukele plan in Honduran territory. "Fast and punctual: zero tolerance with those scoundrels and two, the Bukele plan, we are going to do it here in Honduras," he argued. Octavio Pineda becomes Libre's second presidential candidate for the 2029 primary elections, the other candidate remains Rixi Moncada. On his networks, Pineda reported that "I am going to visit all of Honduras. I will be notifying each visit in advance so that those who wish can accompany me, I love you all very much." The Bukele plan was launched in El Salvador under the name "Territorial Control Plan", which generated a break in the relationship between the government and the gangs, which had previously had a pact in prison for gang leaders. This plan included an emergency regime that allowed arrests without a court order, extended the time of administrative detention and authorized the intervention of telecommunications. In addition, the government mobilized the Army and the National Civil Police to capture Salvadorans with police and criminal records in dangerous communities. Another aspect of Nayib Bukele's plan is that changes were made to the judicial system, including the elimination of names of judges in cases related to the emergency regime. Various sectors in Honduras have stated that this plan cannot be applied in national territory, firstly due to the difference in geographical size of El Salvador and Honduras, other sectors argue that it can and Octavio Pineda announced that he will do so if he reaches the Presidential House.

data.title: Presidente Asfura sostiene encuentro bilateral con su homólogo dominicano, Luis Abinader
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -En el marco toma de posesión del nuevo presidente de Colombia, Abelardo de la Espriella, el presidente de la República, Nasry Asfura, sostuvo un encuentro bilateral con el presidente de República Dominicana, Luis Abinader, en Cali, Colombia. El objetivo de la reunión fue fortalecer los lazos de amistad, cooperación y desarrollo entre ambas naciones. En la reunión participó la delegación gubernamental de República Dominicana y por Honduras acompañaron al mandatario la secretaria de Relaciones Exteriores y Cooperación Internacional, Mireya Agüero y la embajadora de Honduras en Colombia, Jacqueline Foglia. Durante el encuentro, ambos mandatarios abordaron temas de interés común, entre ellos: cooperación deportiva, turismo, seguridad, medio ambiente e inversión entre ambas naciones, así como el intercambio de experiencias y buenas prácticas que puedan contribuir al desarrollo de los dos países. En materia económica, el presidente Luis Abinader puso a disposición del presidente Nasry Asfura el Banco de Desarrollo y Exportaciones (BANDEX) de República Dominicana, como una herramienta para explorar oportunidades de inversión y cooperación financiera que puedan beneficiar a Honduras. Asimismo, el presidente Asfura compartió con su homólogo dominicano un panorama sobre la actualidad de Honduras y los avances que impulsa su administración en áreas estratégicas como el fortalecimiento de las reservas internacionales, salud, educación y seguridad. “Honduras está trabajando con determinación para generar más oportunidades para nuestra gente. Estamos fortaleciendo nuestra economía y avanzando en áreas fundamentales como salud, educación y seguridad. La cooperación con países hermanos, como República Dominicana, nos permite abrir nuevas oportunidades de inversión y desarrollo”, dijo el presidente Nasry Asfura. Por su parte, el presidente Luis Abinader destacó la disposición de República Dominicana de continuar estrechando los vínculos con Honduras y compartir sus experiencias en diferentes sectores. “República Dominicana está a la orden para colaborar con Honduras. Queremos fortalecer nuestra cooperación y poner nuestras instituciones y experiencias al servicio de proyectos que generen inversión, empleo y desarrollo para ambos pueblos”, manifestó el mandatario dominicano. Abinader también destacó la importancia de que BANDEX pueda servir como un canal para identificar y acompañar oportunidades de inversión entre ambos países, reafirmando la voluntad de República Dominicana de apoyar las iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento económico de Honduras
data.translatedTitle: President Asfura holds a bilateral meeting with his Dominican counterpart, Luis Abinader
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -As part of the inauguration of the new president of Colombia, Abelardo de la Espriella, the president of the Republic, Nasry Asfura, held a bilateral meeting with the president of the Dominican Republic, Luis Abinader, in Cali, Colombia. The objective of the meeting was to strengthen the ties of friendship, cooperation and development between both nations. The government delegation of the Dominican Republic participated in the meeting and the president was accompanied by the Secretary of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Mireya Agüero, and the Honduran ambassador to Colombia, Jacqueline Foglia, on behalf of Honduras. During the meeting, both leaders addressed topics of common interest, including: sports cooperation, tourism, security, environment and investment between both nations, as well as the exchange of experiences and good practices that can contribute to the development of the two countries. In economic matters, President Luis Abinader made the Development and Export Bank (BANDEX) of the Dominican Republic available to President Nasry Asfura, as a tool to explore investment and financial cooperation opportunities that can benefit Honduras. Likewise, President Asfura shared with his Dominican counterpart an overview of the current situation in Honduras and the progress that his administration is promoting in strategic areas such as strengthening international reserves, health, education and security. "Honduras is working with determination to generate more opportunities for our people. We are strengthening our economy and advancing in fundamental areas such as health, education and security. Cooperation with sister countries, such as the Dominican Republic, allows us to open new opportunities for investment and development," said President Nasry Asfura. For his part, President Luis Abinader highlighted the Dominican Republic's willingness to continue strengthening ties with Honduras and share its experiences in different sectors. "The Dominican Republic is ready to collaborate with Honduras. We want to strengthen our cooperation and put our institutions and experiences at the service of projects that generate investment, employment and development for both peoples," said the Dominican president. Abinader also highlighted the importance of BANDEX being able to serve as a channel to identify and support investment opportunities between both countries, reaffirming the Dominican Republic's willingness to support initiatives that promote the economic growth of Honduras.

data.title: Belinda, la más bella de 2026 según People en Español
data.description: Los Ángeles, Estados Unidos.- La cantante mexicana Belinda lidera la lista de 'Los 50 más bellos' de 2026 de la revista People en Español, que también colocó en posiciones destacadas a la colombiana Karol G, la actriz dominicana Zoe Saldaña, la modelo puertorriqueña Dayanara Torres y el baloncestista mexicano Karim López. La publicación, que describió a la artista mexicana nacida en España como "imparable" y con "buen sentido del humor", destacó sus proyectos de este año, como su rol protagónico en 'Carlota', la próxima serie histórica de HBO sobre la homónima emperatriz de México, y su tema 'Por ella' del Mundial de fútbol. "Los pensamientos, la energía, los valores, la educación, para mí todo eso es belleza y me fijo cada vez más en esos detalles y esos detalles hacen que una persona sea bella por dentro y por fuera", comentó la también actriz de 36 años a la revista sobre su nombramiento. En su sección sobre música, People en Español escogió como la más destacada a la colombiana Karol G, seguida por la mexicana Danna Paola, el puertorriqueño Luis Fonsi, el colombiano Feid y el cubano Cimafunk. En la categoría de actuación lidera la lista la dominicana Zoe Saldaña, por encima de la mexicana Sofía Castro, hija de la actriz y ex primera dama Angélica Rivera, además del brasileño Marcus Ornellas, Jennifer López y la colombiana Danna García. Mientras que en la clasificación de televisión o presentadores de pódcasts aparece en primer lugar Dayanara Torres, Miss Universo en 1993, sobre el conductor venezolano Rodner García, la colombiana Carmen Villalobos, la puertorriqueña Karla Monroig y el cubano William Valdés. Y en la clasificación de deportes, People destacó a Karim López, primer mexicano elegido en la primera ronda de selección de jugadores de la NBA, además del ciclista mexicano Isaac del Toro, el cubanoestadounidense Fernando Mendoza, la árbitra mexicana de fútbol Katia Itzel García y el futbolista español Lamine Yamal. "Los protagonistas de esta lista son solo una muestra de que el deporte tiene cada vez más un rostro latino y acento español", apuntó la publicación.
data.translatedTitle: Belinda, the most beautiful of 2026 according to People en Español
data.translatedDescription: Los Angeles, United States.- The Mexican singer Belinda leads the list of 'The 50 most beautiful' of 2026 by People en Español magazine, which also placed the Colombian Karol G, the Dominican actress Zoe Saldaña, the Puerto Rican model Dayanara Torres and the Mexican basketball player Karim López in prominent positions. The publication, which described the Spanish-born Mexican artist as "unstoppable" and with a "good sense of humor," highlighted her projects this year, such as her leading role in 'Carlota', HBO's upcoming historical series about the eponymous empress of Mexico, and her World Cup song 'Por ella'. "Thoughts, energy, values, education, for me all of that is beauty and I pay more and more attention to those details and those details make a person beautiful inside and out," the 36-year-old actress also commented to the magazine about her appointment. In its music section, People en Español chose the Colombian Karol G as the most notable, followed by the Mexican Danna Paola, the Puerto Rican Luis Fonsi, the Colombian Feid and the Cuban Cimafunk. In the acting category, the Dominican Zoe Saldaña leads the list, above the Mexican Sofía Castro, daughter of the actress and former first lady Angélica Rivera, as well as the Brazilian Marcus Ornellas, Jennifer López and the Colombian Danna García. While in the classification of television or podcast presenters, Dayanara Torres, Miss Universe in 1993, appears in first place over the Venezuelan host Rodner García, the Colombian Carmen Villalobos, the Puerto Rican Karla Monroig and the Cuban William Valdés. And in the sports classification, People highlighted Karim López, the first Mexican chosen in the first round of selection of NBA players, in addition to the Mexican cyclist Isaac del Toro, the Cuban-American Fernando Mendoza, the Mexican soccer referee Katia Itzel García and the Spanish soccer player Lamine Yamal. "The protagonists of this list are just an example that sport increasingly has a Latin face and Spanish accent," the publication noted.

Saates põrkusid optimistlikum vaade riigi toimimisele ja sügav umbusk ametnike kinnituste vastu. Kõiki teemasid ühendas küsimus, kas Eesti riik suudab otsuste pikaajalisi tagajärgi ette näha või tegutseb taas alles siis, kui probleemid on juba käes.
data.translatedTitle: LISTEN TO ⟩ NOON HOUR: When electing the president, the Riigikogu invents new rules every time
data.translatedDescription: In Kuku radio's "Keskpäätunnis" Aimar Altosaar, Ainar Ruussaar and Marek Strandberg discussed three politically hot topics: the presidential elections that have become confused, the placement of Swedish prisoners in Tartu prison and illegal immigrants arriving in Estonia via Latvia. The show clashed with a more optimistic view of how the country works and a deep distrust of officials' assurances. All topics were united by the question of whether the Estonian state can foresee the long-term consequences of decisions or will act again only when the problems are already here.

data.title: New Zealand Targets Russia With 36th Package of Sanctions
data.description: New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters announced a new sanctions package targeting 33 individuals and entities supporting Russia’s war in Ukraine. The 36th round of sanctions focuses on those involved in the forced relocation and “re-education” of Ukrainian children, as well as malicious cyber actors and propagandists. The package also targets individuals supporting Russia’s military-industrial complex and actors from Iran and North Korea. Since March 2022, New Zealand has sanctioned over 2,000 targets.

data.title: Musk Refuses Starlink for Ukrainian Strikes in Russia
data.description: American tech billionaire Elon Musk is refusing to allow Ukraine to use the SpaceX-operated Starlink satellite network for strikes inside Russian territory. President Volodymyr Zelensky asked US President Donald Trump to intervene and pressure Musk to lift the geographical restrictions so Kyiv can target Russian missile batteries. Trump reportedly did not provide a clear answer. Former Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has also attempted to lobby Musk through informal backchannels without success. Musk has repeatedly cited the risk of Russian escalation and told Ukrainian officials that “it is time to make a deal.” The refusal coincides with broader US hesitancy to transfer advanced military technology, with NATO Ambassador Matthew Whitaker recently confirming that Washington will not allow Ukraine to domestically produce Patriot interceptor missiles, walking back earlier promises made by the Trump administration.

Musk has repeatedly cited the risk of Russian escalation and told Ukrainian officials that “it is time to make a deal.” The refusal coincides with broader US hesitancy to transfer advanced military technology, with NATO Ambassador Matthew Whitaker recently confirming that Washington will not allow Ukraine to domestically produce Patriot interceptor missiles, walking back earlier promises made by the Trump administration.

data.title: Drones Swarm German Patriot Repair Base
data.description: German security services are on high alert following multiple suspicious drone flights over a critical Bundeswehr base in Mechernich, North Rhine-Westphalia. The highly secure facility houses a massive underground logistics warehouse and serves as Europe’s sole “Patriot shipyard,” where the US-made air defense systems are repaired. Between 10:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. local time on Aug. 7, security personnel and local police observed at least six drones flying over the base. Military police suspect the aircraft were Chinese-made Foxtech Fly-380 VTOL models, which have a 400km range.

data.title: Drone Explodes in Bulgaria After Crossing From Romania
data.description: An unidentified drone carrying a substantial explosive payload entered Bulgarian airspace from Romania and detonated in a field near the Kardam border crossing on Saturday morning. Prime Minister Rumen Radev confirmed that the device evaded radar detection due to its low flight altitude. The explosion caused no casualties or infrastructure damage, though it occurred near a Trans-Balkan gas pipeline facility. Bulgaria is redeploying border personnel and anti-drone equipment to its northern border while authorities investigate the incident’s origin.

data.title: Ukraine Agrees to Halt Strikes on Non-Russian Tankers
data.description: Following pressure from the US government and American oil industry, Ukraine has agreed to halt its drone strikes on non-Russian oil tankers and maritime infrastructure linked to the Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal in Novorossiysk. Under the US-brokered deal, vessels are guaranteed safe passage if they do not carry Russian cargo, are not Russian-owned, and are not under Ukrainian sanctions. The agreement comes after July strikes disrupted Chevron’s Kazakh oil operations, prompting Washington to intervene to protect the vital CPC export route amid surging global oil prices ahead of the November US midterm elections.

data.title: Pentagon Removes General Overseeing Ukraine Military Support
data.description: The Pentagon has prematurely removed Lt. Gen. Charles Costanza from his command of the US 5th Army Corps, approximately two months before his scheduled handover. The 5th Army Corps plays a crucial role in coordinating US ground forces in Europe, securing NATO’s eastern flank, and facilitating military assistance to Ukraine. While the reasons for the early dismissal remain undisclosed, it occurs amid broader sweeping personnel changes by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who has recently dismissed over two dozen senior officers and initiated a review to reduce US troop levels in Europe. Brig. Gen. John B. Mountford is currently serving as acting commander until Maj. Gen. Thomas Feltey assumes the role in October.

data.title: Kim Jong Un Reaps $22 Billion Windfall from Russian Alliance
data.description: North Korea amassed up to $22 billion in foreign revenue between 2022 and 2025, primarily by supplying arms and troops to Russia. North Korea provided up to 50% of Russia’s 122mm and 152mm artillery shell requirements and earned roughly $2,000 per month for each of the 16,000 to 22,000 soldiers it deployed to support Moscow. The financial windfall has fueled a rapid expansion of Pyongyang’s nuclear and naval capabilities.

data.title: European Allies Warn Russia Against South Ossetia Annexation
data.description: The United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Italy issued a joint statement on the 18th anniversary of the 2008 Russo-Georgian War, warning Moscow against the potential full-scale annexation of the occupied South Ossetia region. The allies expressed concern over a recent “alliance and cooperation” agreement and the appointment of a Russian citizen as the region’s de-facto leader, stating such moves would not go unanswered. The nations also condemned Russia’s ongoing militarization of Abkhazia and South Ossetia, urged compliance with a 2025 European Court of Human Rights ruling regarding abuses in the occupied territories, and welcomed the Republic of Nauru’s recent decision to revoke its recognition of the breakaway regions.

data.title: Remains of 55 Volhynia Massacre Victims Exhumed
data.description: Following four weeks of excavation work, Poland’s Institute of National Remembrance (IPN), alongside Ukrainian experts, recovered the remains of 55 victims of the Volhynia massacres at the sites of the former villages of Ostrówki and Wola Ostrowiecka in western Ukraine. The victims, primarily women and children under the age of 12, were found in mass graves showing forensic evidence of executions, including gunshot wounds and blunt force trauma. Investigators also recovered over 300 personal and religious artifacts. DNA samples have been collected for identification, and the remains will be buried at the Ostrówki cemetery on August 30.

data.title: Ukrainian Attacks Threaten Mass Bankruptcies in Russia
data.description: A sustained Ukrainian drone campaign targeting the logistics network of Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries threatens to trigger a wave of mass bankruptcies among independent sellers. Hundreds of billions of rubles in inventory have been destroyed across 20 targeted warehouses, and the state lacks the funds for direct compensation. Because individual entrepreneurs are personally liable for debt under Russian law, many face the loss of personal assets. The crisis follows systematic strikes that have destroyed 1.2 million square meters (12.9 million square feet) of capacity and knocked at least eight of the company’s 15 largest hubs offline.

The targeted strike on the hospital preceded another night of intense aerial bombardment across Ukraine, including a combined drone and ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv early Saturday morning that injured four people and sparked massive fires across two city districts.

The shift in travel patterns follows an Aug. 3 incident in which a Ukrainian drone, allegedly targeting a defense contractor’s recreation facility, was intercepted by Russian air defenses and fell on a crowded beach in the Krasnodar region.

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. data.translatedTitle: DSP the Greedy Machiavellian
data.translatedDescription: Guineans, once again, I come to warn you about the danger that Domingos Simões Pereira represents for Guinea-Bissau. I issue this warning to all Guineans without exception, whether in the country or abroad, to PAIGC in particular and to Cipriano Cassamá in particular. This warns about the true DSP, the true spirit that moves this guy, which some still continue to believe in, not to say adore. Domingos Simões Pereira is a manipulator, a true blackmailer and probably calculating, a type of behavior that goes beyond the level of psychopath. A disproportionately ambitious man, a true criminal who knows how and when to commit the crime. He would never cohabit not only with JOMAV, as well as with any president who would be elected, except the one he covertly supported. This is because he has his own agenda, and PAIGC is simply a platform for its achievement. DSP would never cohabit with JOMAV because its preferred candidate was Paulo Gomes and always will be, who together with Tchitchi are outlining a mechanism to become the new owners of Guinea-Bissau. According to them, this is a medium-term process, and it takes courage and patience to achieve it. Winning the congress no matter what the circumstances and having the party in hand again, is a phase completed to their advantage, while true PAIGC activists are clapping. After this legislative election, no matter the result, Cipriano Cassama must prepare his suitcase or keep his mouth shut, as the preferred candidate for the party will be Paulo Gomes, and he must have a voice within the party. DSP is a disproportionately ambitious person, he never had any consideration for anyone, JOMAV even less so, the guy is a born Machiavellian, Cipriano Casama will be discarded when he least expects it and he can take notice. Guineans, talking about Paulo Gomes and Tchitchi is talking about MCCI and other organizations and camouflaged personalities in our country. These two individuals are the main financiers of MCCI and other well-known personalities in the city of Bissau. The MCCI, Militia created by JBV and DSP, now financed and directed by the "future triangle of power" that is, "DSP, Paulo Gomes and Tchitchi", has 3 main objectives: 1st Disrupt public order in the name of citizenship, defame and attempt to discredit any organizations or individuals not aligned with the triangle, in order to support their journeys in search of power. 2nd If the objective of the triangle is achieved, the role of the MCCI Militia will become constant surveillance of all adversaries in order to guarantee false social peace and the power of control. 3rd Try to gain credibility with international and regional organizations, through your visits and cover activities, so that when there are public disturbances, they can gain notoriety. But this should not worry anyone, as they are well identified and well hunted, inside and outside Guinea-Bissau. data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio.
